name: FL-MedSegBench
description: Federated learning (FL) offers a privacy-preserving paradigm for collaborative medical image analysis without sharing raw data. However, the absence of standardized benchmarks for medical image segmentation hinders fair and comprehensive evaluation of FL methods. To address this gap, we introduce FL-MedSegBench, the first comprehensive benchmark for federated learning on medical image segmentation. Our benchmark encompasses nine segmentation tasks across ten imaging modalities, covering both 2D and 3D formats with realistic clinical heterogeneity.
